title: 'One-positron cyclotron' could test a key prediction of the Standard Model
title_zh: “单正电子回旋加速器”可以测试标准模型的关键预测
summary: 正电子是电子的反物质对应物，质量相同，但带有相等且相反的电荷。与电子一样，它的行为也像一个微小的条形磁铁，根据粒子物理标准模型的一个关键预测，它的磁矩应该与电子的磁矩完全相等且方向相反。
abstract: The positron is the antimatter counterpart of the electron, identical in mass but carrying an equal and opposite electric charge. Like the electron, it also behaves like a tiny bar magnet, and according to a key prediction of the Standard Model of particle physics, its magnetic moment should be exactly equal and opposite to the electron's.
